resources.name: P-V data of calcite-structure carbonates (Table 1)

access.notes: CSV file containing the room-temperature pressure(GPa), hexagonal lattice parameters a(Å), c(Å) and unit-cell volume V(Å³) for each carbonate (NiCO3, MgCO3, CoCO3, ZnCO3, MnCO3, CdCO3, CaCO3). The file is included in the task assets.

resources.notes: Public data directly transcribed from Table 1 of the paper.
